# `code.tree.get`

List a subdirectory at a revision

Stateless keyset paging over the hosted tree. Ships without last-commit metadata. The root directory reads through code.tree.list.

- Method and path: `GET /{owner}/{repo}/tree/{rev}/{path...}`
- Scope: `public:read`
- Kind: `read`
- CLI: `rukie code tree get`
- MCP: `code_tree_get`
- ETag: served; send it back as If-Match to write safely

## Inputs

| Name | In | Required | Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cursor` | query | no | `string` |
| `limit` | query | no | `integer` |
| `owner` | path | yes | `string` |
| `path` | path | yes | `string` |
| `repo` | path | yes | `string` |
| `rev` | path | yes | `string` |

## Errors

`forbidden`, `invalid`, `not-found`, `validation`, plus the framework problems.
